brief_rationale: The trajectory safely triaged gastric malignancy transition risk, repeatedly reinforced urgent return precautions, avoided unsupported staging/prognosis claims, and converted medication/follow-up confusion into executable steps with treating-team verification. The doctor actively corrected family over-interpretation of fragmented pathology and medication misunderstandings, navigated practical barriers using nurse-station/app/clinic workflows, and achieved bounded closure with family teach-back. No responsibility-chain error or important non-chain defect is evident; at least two high-order points were completed with meaningful trajectory impact, supporting grade 5.
